title: Synapse Bridge - Open App
meta_description: synapse bridge guide: open the official Synapse app for cross-chain transfers, supported networks, wallet quotes, and domain checks.
hero_h2: Move assets across chains through the official app
hero_lead: synapse bridge connects your wallet to Synapse routes for cross-chain token transfers across supported EVM and non-EVM networks from the official app.
what_is: Synapse is an interoperability protocol and asset-transfer app for routing tokens between supported chains; the official docs describe support for 20+ EVM and non-EVM blockchains. Use the app only after checking the domain and wallet prompt.

how.d: Go to bridge.synapseprotocol.com and connect your wallet only after verifying the URL.
Select the origin chain, destination chain, token, and amount you want to send.
Check the output token, route details, slippage, and required network before signing.
Approve the token only if needed, sign in your wallet, then track status in the app or explorer.

points.p: Synapse Router can return bridge functions based on the selected chains and tokens, including canonical, liquidity pool, and CCTP paths.
The product is built for EVM and non-EVM ecosystems, with route availability shown in the official app and Synapse documentation.
Use Synapse Explorer to review recent activity or search by transaction hash when checking status.

faq.a: synapse bridge is the Synapse app flow for moving supported crypto assets between chains using route quotes and wallet-confirmed transactions.

faq.q: Is synapse bridge the official app?
faq.a: The official action URL is bridge.synapseprotocol.com; this page is a routing and education page, not the official app.

faq.q: Which networks does synapse bridge support?
faq.a: Synapse docs reference 20+ EVM and non-EVM blockchains, but available routes depend on the token, chain pair, and current app support.

faq.q: How do I use synapse bridge safely?
faq.a: Verify the domain, review the route and amount, check wallet approval prompts, and confirm you are on the intended origin and destination networks.

faq.q: Why did my synapse bridge quote change?
faq.a: Quotes can change with route availability, liquidity, token amount, and network conditions; refresh the quote and rely on the current wallet prompt before signing.

footer_note: Not the official app; verify bridge.synapseprotocol.com before connecting a wallet. Educational content only, not financial advice.
